noise_floor.control: Use an eager control measured against the same fp64 reference; never substitute control-versus-eager RMSE. Unsupported or absent controls are explicitly omitted from the max and recorded.

noise_floor.rationale: A fixed 32-unit-roundoff scale term prevents a nearly exact eager reference from being the sole denominator. It is an engineering floor, not a rigorous operation-count error bound or an estimate fitted to these models.

intervention.reason: No generated GELU kernel reaches exp_u20. Both forward/backward use SLEEF tanh. The disabled tanh decomposition would use regular vector exp already; enabling it changes the formula, not an exp_u20 call.

code_audit.scope: Complete source-build cached modules/C++ for all three workers per build; original boundary-nightly debug dumps also searched. Source-level and linked-symbol resolution for the observed AVX512 tanh paths. Native flash forward calls reach exp_u20 separately; they are not generated GELU C++ kernels.

captures.method: Immediate TorchDispatchMode capture of MLP expansion addmm outputs and eager tanh operands; compiled forward/backward warmed before invoking the existing backend callable. Compiled tanh argument is reconstructed in fp64, not directly observed.

ranges.interpretation: Counterfactual exp_u20 evaluations at saved coordinates are not actual GELU call-path exposure. Observed disagreement fractions do not explain gradient propagation.
